build_huggingface_dataset_builder: build a HuggingfaceDatasetBuilder instance from a Huggingface repo ID and optional config name
create_hf_features_to_tfds: create a TFDS feature spec by converting Huggingface feature definitions to TensorFlow Dataset features
convert_hf_to_tfds_name: convert a Huggingface dataset name to a TFDS-compatible name by replacing special characters
convert_config_name: convert a Huggingface config name to a TFDS-compatible config name by lowercasing and replacing commas
login_to_huggingface_hub: log in to Hugging Face Hub using a provided token or the HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN environment variable
